title: Oklahoma debuts internal AI platform with two ‘lighthouse’ tools for legislators, procurement
summary: Oklahoma's new internal and enterprise artificial intelligence platform is designed to help state agencies build new tools.

title: States may need to cut one-third of BEAD satellite awards after broadband data update
summary: Changes to location eligibility, brought on by newly available data, arrive as the federal government's keystone broadband program moves into its final phases.

title: Oregon names Nevada’s communications, policy lead as state privacy chief
summary: Michael Hanna-Butros Meyering, Nevada's chief communications and policy officer, will now help Oregon translate privacy principles into practical decisions and repeatable processes, according to a state announcement.

title: Pennsylvania Gov. Josh Shapiro announces $125M startup accelerator
summary: Funding included in the state's latest budget will support young companies in Pennsylvania's life sciences industry.

title: ‘Trust-first’ data-sharing can better connect young mothers to California benefits, report argues
summary: A new report from the Family Benefits Lab urges California state agencies to use its already extensive data infrastructure to proactively connect young mothers with benefits.

title: California officials highlight AI, FireSat and predictive technologies as centerpieces in state wildfire strategy
summary: Speaking at Sacramento McClellan Airport, California Gov. Gavin Newsom tallied the many cutting-edge firefighting technologies to have been adopted since he took office.

title: AI-driven data inferencing is outpacing state privacy protections, watchdogs warn
summary: Data-privacy experts said on a recent panel that while state privacy laws regulate what data brokers can collect and sell, those laws often do not extend to the problematic conclusions those companies can infer.

title: Cyberattack against Maine telecom disrupted municipal internet service
summary: A cyberattack against a telecommunication firm in Maine knocked out internet service for more than 20 towns along the state's midcoastal region.

title: ‘Integrated’ cyber and physical attacks concerned FIFA planners
summary: “The threat environment has changed" and the lines between physical and digital attacks have blurred, said one security expert involved in FIFA World Cup Planning.

title: North Carolina commissioner named president of National Association of Counties
summary: As the National Association of Counties' latest president, North Carolina Commissioner George Dunlap will lead an initiative aimed at improving outcomes for young people.
